title: Mixed Event — Time to RE:START!

meta.Outline: Eager to make MORE MORE JUMP! official, Airi and the others waste no time in searching for an agency to join, but...

rows.Line:
By giving everything we've got to our role,
we're able to pass on those feelings of working hard
                    for tomorrow to our fans.

So no matter how uncertain or tough things get,
   we keep looking forward to stay positive and
make sure to give everyone the smiles they need.

I still remember when I first decided that I wanted to
                    become that sort of idol.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Hey! How many times do I have to tell you not to make my sister cry before you get it through your thick skulls?!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: Shut up! You sure talk big for a pipsqueak!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully
rows.Line: Yeah, why don't you take your crybaby sister and get lost!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: Hmph! Better run home to mommy while you still can!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Who are you calling a pipsqueak...?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Apologize right now or we'll see who the crybaby really is!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Ow! Oww! Mom, stop!
Please be more gentle!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
I am, but you need to hold still!
I can't stop until I'm done disinfecting this.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Hrng... Fine...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Sometimes I wish you weren't such a tomboy.
Do you always have to go pick fights with boys?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: You come with your clothes all dirty and your hair all messed up after I spent so much time on it. And you ate so many daifuku that you started to choke...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What does the last one have to do with anything?!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Besides, I'm fine!
I'm used to getting into fights!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: That's not the point! How can you be proud of that?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I-I know but...!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Hey, what's this song?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, that's just the TV...
I think they said it's by some idol that just debuted...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Really...?
She's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you think so? There's no reason you can't be just as cute as she is, you know.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
(Can I really be more like...
An idol?)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, she's on a variety show today!
She always looks so cute!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Idols sure are amazing...
Singing, dancing, making all those people smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: They even do all those talk shows! I bet it's a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
You've been watching this girl a lot lately.
Do you really like her that much?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like just seeing her makes me happy. I can't help but start smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: That means she's just like you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't help but start smiling whenever I see you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Maybe I really can be an idol!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I bet I could get up on a big stage like her and sing and dance and make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Alright then...!
I'm going to become an idol!
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, I went to audition after audition before finally becoming an idol like I dreamed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That sure brings back memories.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It wasn't all sunshine and rainbows but...
I really did love being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks to Minori and the others, I get another chance at doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm going to put everything I've got into being a part of MORE MORE JUMP!
Talent Agency - Outside

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...! This building is huge!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this the right place, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked a few of my friends to look for an agency they think might be interested in us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And this agency agreed to talk to us about the four of us as a group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
If that's true, that would be amazing.
Working for an agency as big as this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Minori Hanasato, ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I take it you're a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
You just need to be yourself, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly. Your smile is your best quality.
Have confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right! Thanks, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's more like it.
Alright, let's go in!
Talent Agency - Inside

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning. My name is Haruka Kiritani. I have an appointment.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka! We've been expecting you!
I see Shizuku and Airi are with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing us!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Of course. We're happy that you came.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Um!
Thank you for seeing us!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Hm? You must be a friend of theirs.
Are you here for a tour of the agency?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, we're here as a group of four. Could you give us an explanation regarding agency transfers?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh, my apologies! I didn't realize...
Please wait here for just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew it. I just look like an outsider here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You'll be fine!
Everyone does when they first start out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's right, Minori.
I wouldn't worry too much about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right! Sorry, everyone.
If only I had more of an idol-like aura...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I guess if I did, I wouldn't have had so much trouble passing my auditions...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about? It's really rare to get hired as a full-blown idol right off the bat.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An idol is born by working hard day after day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Shizuku might be an exception...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose that's true. I don't know about having the right aura, but working hard every day is very important.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been doing that ever since I first became an idol and I'm still nowhere close to my ideal image.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You too, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. So let's do our best together, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once you get some experience with an agency, you'll start feeling like a real idol in no time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks again, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You all have a big head start, so I'll have to put in a lot of effort to catch up! More, more, more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe! That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Please, follow me!

rows.Speaker: All Four
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!
CEO's Office

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Ah, I've been expecting you.
Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We only just recently formed MORE MORE JUMP! but the four of us are looking forward to seeing what we can do together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We wish to be the kind of idols who can spread hope and happiness to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We look forward to working wiff you!

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: Hm? The four of you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, sir!

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: That might be a bit difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What...?
Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: Our agency would be happy to take you, Ms. Hinomori and Ms. Momoi, but I was not aware you would be bringing an amateur with you as well.

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: I'm sorry for the misunderstanding, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on...!
Wait just a minute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori here may not have much experience yet, but she has tenacity and a drive to become a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's just a sapling now, but I can guarantee you she'll shine just as brightly on stage as any of us before you know it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, please...!

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Very well.
You've made your intentions quite clear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: I would be happy to take on all four of you, but I'm afraid I can't agree to you performing as a single unit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Talent Agency CEO
rows.Line: Marketing an idol group comprised of three famous members and one completely unknown amateur would simply be too difficult. I'm sure you can understand our position.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I... I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, I'm afraid we must decline.
Thank you again for your time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry everyone...
Especially after coming all this way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not your fault! If only I was more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: More...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you getting so down for?
That was only one agency!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What happened to the Minori who keeps at it no matter how many times she got knocked down, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... When I fail an audition, the only one that gets hurt is me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Now I'm dragging all of you down as well.
It's all my fault that you won't...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, I agree with Airi.
It's too soon to give up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We still have plenty of other connections, so let's just keep looking for an agency that will work with us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We knew this wasn't going to be easy.
There's no reason to get discouraged yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we aren't going to leave everything up to Haruka either. I still have a few strings I can pull too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know some people from when I was still modelling who I can speak with as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi... Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right. I can't let one agency get me down. I'll do what I can too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the spirit! We're just getting started, and we're gonna find a way to get over these obstacles together, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's all do our part and see what we can come up with!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!!
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sigh...
This isn't going so well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The agency I talked to said they'd only hire me and put Haruka and Shizuku at another agency under the same parent company.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another agency I spoke with said they would only sign Shizuku and me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I went to a bunch of different agencies to ask if they'd let us audition, but they all turned me down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been asking some of the smaller agencies as well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The last few days, they've started hanging up on me as soon as I gave them my name.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I wonder why...
They were willing to hear us out before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if we asked different agencies to hire us each separately and see if they'll agree to let us work together as a group?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I thought about that too. However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no guarantee that they will allow us to perform as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That first agency did say that marketing me along with all of you would be too difficult. They're probably all thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also have to remember that every agency already has idols working for them, and that they want them to succeed too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The chances of finding an agency that is willing to let us debut as a group when there is no guarantee that we will succeed may be slim.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're right...
The debuting process costs a lot of money so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sob...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew it. You would all be better off without...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're not doing this without you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're the reason why the three of us even decided to become idols again, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, there are still a lot of places we haven't tried yet. So no more complaining for now, got it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...! I'll do my best...!
Talent Agency - Outside

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Turned down again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We barely got in a word before they kicked us out...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really thought this might be the one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something's not right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The agency we talked to the other day seemed really excited at first, but now we're getting turned away at the door.
Well, if it isn't Airi and Haruka. And two friends as well... I take it the rumors I've been hearing are true then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. It's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Who's that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He's a producer I used to work with on some TV shows a while back. I guess Airi knows him as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep! He's really nice to work with!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on...
Didn't he just say something about a rumor?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't think there's a strange rumor going around about us, do you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that why we're getting shot down before agencies even meet with us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's a distinct possibility.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If someone started some awful rumor about us...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about this rumor you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing bad. I just heard that the four of you were looking for an agency is all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?
Is that all?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why would that turn into agencies refusing to meet with us?

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: The agency you worked for before was one of the big ones, Haruka. Now, you've even teamed up with Airi and Shizuku to boot...

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: From a smaller agency's point of view, hiring three big names, such as yourselves, comes with the risk of making the big agencies think you were cherry picked.

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: They could also come under pressure from your old agencies and cause other idols to lose work.

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: From what I've heard, that's what everyone's worried about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Famous Producer
rows.Line: Finding an agency won't be easy, but good luck with your new group. I hope we get the chance to work together again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to it!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the big agencies and even the small ones are out...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't think about how an agency would come under fire just because they hired us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This means no one is gonna want to work with us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know we were prepared for this, but that doesn't make it any easier to accept.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this isn't the kind of problem we can solve with positive thinking alone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, come on, you guys.
Don't get so down!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're supposed to give our fans hope, right? We can't give up now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right... We need to figure out our next step.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Indeed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping it wasn't true, but we might have to consider what could happen if our old agencies really did put pressure on whoever we end up working for...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's a possibility we could end up destroying the hopes of other idols in the process...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can't do that...! I would never forgive myself if I was the reason another idol lost the ability to smile!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe we just aren't meant to be on stage after all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's not true...!
There has to be something we can do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to keep trying! I'm not ready to give up looking for a path to becoming idols!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
Sorry. I'm just upset.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry too...!
I still have to try even more!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we're all a little exhausted right now. Perhaps it would be best to call it a day and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I think you're right. Maybe we'll think of something once we've had the chance to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try to think of something too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, just get some rest, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you really can't sit still, use your energy to practice dancing or singing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Be careful on your way home, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will do! See ya!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No way I'm giving up now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need to do everything in my power to make this work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello? Yes, this is...
The next day
CEO's Office

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Momoi. It's been a while...
The last time we spoke was when you quit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me, sir. I was hoping to ask you something.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line:
Ah, I believe I've heard.
You're trying to form a new group, correct?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I already gave up on being an idol once, but a lot has happened with the girls in my group and we've finally come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The four of us want to be idols together.
We want to get back up on that stage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, please!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know I'm in no position to ask you this after transferring to another agency and then quitting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you won't ever hear another complaint from me. Variety programs, talent work... I'll do anything your agency needs me to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Please! All I ask is that you let us the four of us join together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will you consider us?!

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I see. Your friends must be very precious to you if you're willing to go that far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, they are...!

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: However, I have no way to say for sure that hiring Ms. Kiritani and Ms. Hinomori won't have a negative effect on the other girls' job offers.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: If it were just you, I would actually consider it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I understand. I apologize for asking something as unreasonable as this.

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I see. That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Agency CEO
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd be a little more pragmatic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for your time...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
That was my last connection.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great...!
Now I'm letting it get to me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the four of us decided to spread hope together! We have to keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Will I really have the chance to be an idol again?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No! I can't let myself think like that!
It'll only make me feel worse!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is exactly when I need to act more like an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I need a song to pick me up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is always my favorite group to listen to when I'm feeling down. Somehow, they always manage to put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Idols sure are amazing...
Singing, dancing, making all those people smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
You've been watching this girl a lot lately.
Do you really like her that much?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like just seeing her makes me happy. I can't help but start smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Watching that idol shining on the TV like that always made me smile...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's the one who gave me the motivation to keep working hard day after day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's also the reason I wanted to become an idol too. I wanted to help spread those feelings to even more people.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess that isn't pragmatic...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still...
I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is your SEKAI. Come back and visit any time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Especially if you're ever feeling down!
We'll make sure to cheer you right back up♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wonder if I'll get any ideas if I visit now...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi!
You came to visit♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hi, Rin. It's been a while.
You're as energetic as ever.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd come to visit again soon! Does this mean we're all singing together again?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, um, actually...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but...? Where's everyone else? Are you alone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Um, yeah...
It's just me today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: N-No, I'm...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... There's no point in trying to act tough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Besides, you've already seen me at my worst.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're usually so full of energy, but I get worried about you when you look so upset.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're exaggerating.
It's not that serious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's just... A lot happened recently.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know what's troubling you, but I can see that it's something very important.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can tell...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's easy!
I can see right through everything, you know!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whether it's about you, everyone else who isn't here today, the weather tomorrow, even what you're going to have for dinner! I can see it all!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're definitely making some of that up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you got me! Hehehe♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But...
I do feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have something to ask you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you sing me a song you think will help put a big smile on my face?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is that all? Coming right up!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have just the song for such an occasion!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This one's sure to make you smile and bring back the happy, energetic Airi everyone loves!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, get ready to have some fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Start the music!
Stage SEKAI
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Rin really is amazing.
Always so bright and energetic...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't help but smile when I watch her.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I knew it. Idols have to be able to face anything head on with a smile.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's what I need to do...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
How was that, Airi?
Do you feel any better?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, much!
That was a terrific performance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're so incredible, Rin.
A real idol who always keeps on smiling.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so? I think you're just as much of an idol as I am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Thanks.
But it only looks that way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you mind telling me what happened...? Maybe I can help out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And even if I can't, I'm happy to just listen! I'm sure you'll feel a lot better either way!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! You don't have to if you don't want to, of course! I'm just really, really curious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. In that case...
I could really use some advice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I've admired idols ever since I was little.
Seeing them shine on stage like they do...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like the way you did just now, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wha—?! Really?!
Hehehe, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I used to be obsessed with watching idol music videos. I'd try to copy their songs and dance routines.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I decided that's what I wanted to be too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But back then, I didn't look anything like an idol should.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
How so?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I used to get into fights with some boys in my neighborhood. Most days, I'd come home with my clothes all dirty.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
You've really always been like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you could at least act more surprised! The only time I get my clothes dirty now is when I have to for work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I guess I have always been told that my energy was a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyways, moving on...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Becoming an idol takes a lot of time and money, so I know it couldn't have been easy on my family.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But despite everything, they were always there to support me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I poured everything into working hard day after day until I was finally able to achieve my goal!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But in the end, things didn't go exactly as I'd hoped.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see... So that's what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I decided to try again really hard after giving up once already but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For some reason, I just can't seem to get any closer to the idols I looked up to so much when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm starting to think that I'm never going to be able to spread hope to others like I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's not true!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think you're a great idol, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whenever I see you up on that stage, it makes me smile so much that I want to get up there with you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I want to see you perform more!
I want to sing with you again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Please...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Acting so discouraged isn't like me at all, is it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin. We'll just have to put our heads together and come up with another way to keep MORE MORE JUMP! alive!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But there's something that's bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is there some kind of rule that says idols have to be part of one of these agencies you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, Miku, me and the others don't work for an agency, and we still do shows all the time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's true...
But I don't think that would work for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Without an agency, we'd be freelancing as idols...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think that's a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I mean... If you're not with an agency, you won't be able to do performances or get onto TV shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So nobody will ever see you.
How can we spread hope like that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm... I'm not sure I can answer a question like that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still believe you'd find a way to make it work!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take this SEKAI, for example. All of these different stages were created through everyone's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You have as many wonderful feelings here, so I feel like you'd be capable of anything if you put your minds to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The four of you are sure to become an idol group that can give hope to anyone, anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's what I believe!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I have faith!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow will always be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So in order to help everyone believe things can always get better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow! Those are the words that guide me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Give hope to anyone, anywhere... I guess we need to keep on believing as long as there's the possibility.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin.
It's time to give it another go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Next time, I'll make sure to bring everyone else with me so we can all sing together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay!
I can't wait♪
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Talking to Rin was the right thing to do!
Her show was the perfect pick me up too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now it's time to do whatever I can as a proud member of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That said, this isn't gonna be easy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's start by doing some research into whether we can even manage as an independent group.
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait.
Here's your iced mocha.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming!
Enjoy your drink!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Part-Time Staff Leader
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Hanasato?
You seem a little out of it today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I... I'm sorry! I was worrying about something last night and had a time hard falling asleep. Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Part-Time Staff Leader
rows.Line: Oh, really? It's a bit early, but why don't you go ahead and take your break now? That should help a little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I'll be back right after lunch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No... Now I'm causing problems at work... I need to focus after my break is over!)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
Hey, stop it!
Put that camera away...!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Ugh! You better erase that video!

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Why? The viewers love little behind-the-scenes glimpses like this one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It sounds like they're taking a video.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... A video...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I remember watching a lot of videos online when I was learning how to do different dances.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It was really convenient, and there were tons of different videos to choose from too...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Whenever I had a little time, I'd watch idols...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh my goodness! That's it! If MORE MORE JUMP! started uploading videos like the idols I saw in those videos...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I've never done anything like that before. I wonder how hard it would be to...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, we won't know unless we try!
That's the first step!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hello viewers!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to introduce you to someone... Me! Ta-daaa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm... I guess I already told you my name so... I'm a first-year high school student and a member of the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One of my favorite hobbies is keeping a daily diary!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I usually write about what happened that day or what kind of practice I did after school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, wait! This is a video...
I guess I can just show you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see... Here we go.
Is this in focus? I sure hope you can see this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I also love learning different idols' dance routines! Here, I'll do a quick demonstration for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let me just put the camera down and... Oh, this might be too low. All you can see is my feet, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe I can find somewhere a bit higher... Oh, let me try over here... There, that should work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gasp! Noooo!
The camera's gonna fall over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sob... The camera wouldn't focus on my diary and I couldn't find a good spot to record a dance video.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can't even see half of my face in most of video either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Making a video is harder than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...?
What's the matter, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, actually...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. So you decided to try making a video?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't become an idol if I just sit around and mope. I need to do whatever I can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Uploading videos of us doing idol activities, huh?
That's certainly one way of doing things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm impressed, Minori.
I think it's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's just an idea I had!
Besides, I couldn't really get it to work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but even if something seems difficult on your own, it may become easier by working together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to give it a try.
Let's see what the others think as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thanks, Shizuku!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Talent Insider
rows.Line: <I'm very sorry, but I just don't see that working out for us.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for your time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another dead end...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought maybe an agency just getting off the ground might be open to the idea, but I guess I was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm starting to think we may never find an agency that's willing to take us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I need to stay positive. It wouldn't be right to give up hope while the others are still trying so hard...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Who else might be willing to meet with us? I've already contacted so many people...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, this girl! She freelances as a celebrity...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember her talking about how much she loved her job despite how much work it was.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Freelancing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wonder if we could be an independent idol group that isn't affiliated with a talent agency.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's not realistic. That person works solo too and has much more flexibility in terms of finding work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's hard to think that we could do the same as a four-member idol group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then... What on Earth are we going to do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's from Airi...?
I wonder what's going on?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, don't worry about it! But I am wondering why you asked us to come up here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was surprised as well since you called so late about wanting to discuss something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can all relax a bit, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I finally managed to sort out some ideas I had and I wanted to let you know as soon as I did!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it you want to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, here's the thing. I have a suggestion about how we might be able to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Move forward... As MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. Obviously, you all know we've been having trouble with agencies, so I did some thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about we ditch the idea of finding a talent agency and become an independent idol group instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Like... Freelancing...?
Do you mean that, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course I do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The way things are now, I don't think we're going to find an agency that's gonna be willing to work with us any time soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So instead of wasting our time on that, I thought it'd be much better to start doing stuff on our own.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be true, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's going to be extremely difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As an independent group, we'd be responsible for handling everything old managers and staff used to handle. Scheduling, meetings, you name it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Doing all of that while also making the time to practice won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And we won't have a producer.
How will we handle marketing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get that it won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think between the two of us, we'll be able to manage scheduling and marketing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You and me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're always so organized and you have the most experience out of any of us. I think you'd be great at it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'd be there to help too. I'm not gonna make you handle everything on your own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Um, is there any way for me to help out? I want to do something, even if it's running random errands!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I would like to do my part as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I was already planning on asking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I actually spent the whole day yesterday researching what QT has done since they first formed. I looked at what shows they've been on, what kind of interviews, everything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: None of us have any real experience doing that kind of stuff ourselves, so I figured we'd need as much reference material as possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, it's all pretty vague since all I have to go on are whatever schedules and information I could find online.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also gathered everything I could find on the promotional stuff that was used for a bunch of the idols who recently debuted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's so much...!
It's bigger than a textbook!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure there's still a lot missing, but I think this should be enough to figure out how to market MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if we do our own marketing, do you think we'll still get work if we're not part of an agency? How are we going to actually get up on stage to perform?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And if we don't perform, how are the fans going to see us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh! I actually have a suggestion about that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku's been helping me record some videos!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We only just started, but if it goes well enough, we could upload them to streaming sites! That might help us get exposure even without being on TV!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Recording our own videos...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a good idea. We can make our own videos without any extra staff on hand...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After listening to what Airi said, I'm convinced that the four of us can do anything together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We may not be performing on big stages or popular TV shows yet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if we split the work and start doing things our own way, I'm sure people will take notice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree with Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where we might be doesn't matter. As long as people are able to find us, we'll be able to spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know it's going to be tough, but I want to do whatever we can to keep going. I don't want to give up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As long as we're together, I believe we can overcome any obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori... Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. We all decided that we're gonna spread hope to others, didn't we? That means we have to take on whatever challenges that come our way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're right...
There's never just one path.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi, thank you for suggesting this.
I... I think I was being a little stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have the promotional research Airi put together, and a video-based approach devised by Minori and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's still no way of telling how things will go, but I'll do my best to help however I can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If this is the path you all think we should take, then we just gotta figure out how to walk it together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... How about we start by taking some practice videos after school today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, you and Shizuku could start by teaching us what you've tried so far. Does that sound good?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! I'll put some notes together before then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I should start adding recording days to my calendar.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! I bet writing Recording Day on my schedule would make me feel more like a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe! I'm gonna put that in my planner for sure♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll add it as well.
It'll help get me into the right state of mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad everyone's smiling again...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (An optimistic mindset is key to being an idol. No matter what happens, you keep smiling and never give up.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So no more looking down! We're going to prove that the four of us have what it takes!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright! We officially start working today as idols! As MORE MORE JUMP!
